findings.description: Picking the last element as pivot with Lomuto partition makes quicksort degrade to O(n^2) time and O(n) recursion depth on already-sorted or adversarial input.

The quicksort/partition API takes int indices. In general use, signed/unsigned conversions to size_t on vector::operator[] can underflow/overflow if callers pass invalid values, leading to OOB access.
